name: BLAW 3274
title: Real Estate Law
description: (Also offered as BADM 3274.) This course provides an introduction to the legal and ethical aspects of real estate law. Students learn to explain and distinguish basic legal concepts related to ownership, real estate interests, real estate closings, brokerage, property management, financing methods, and taxation. Students gain practical experience navigating legal documents and performing a limited title search.
requirement_description: BLAW 3175 or BADM 3720; open only to business majors of junior or higher status.
